Numbrid teada: nii palju tõuseb uuel aastal inimeste maamaks
estonia.description: Maksu- ja tolliamet avalikustas 2027. aasta maamaksumäärad. Paaris vallas tabab inimesi 100-protsendine maamaksutõus.

estonia.title: Lambaid pole siin ja lambaid pole sääl, sest nad kolisid talveks linnast ära
estonia.description: Sügisel loetakse tibusid, kuid mitte ainult. Ka jõudsalt peale tükkiva võõrliigi Kanada kuldvitsa tõrjumise edukuse kohta annab teha järeldusi nüüd, mil Ülejõel Ujula tänava liivakivipaljandit suvel hooldanud lambad on sealt läinud.

estonia.title: TÄISPIKK VIDEO ⟩ Even Tudeberg mürsuskandaalist: nähti kullakoormat ja hakati seda seljakottidesse lappama, kõik tahavad ju rikaste edetabelisse pürgida
estonia.description: Esmaspäevases «Kuuuurija» saates räägib ettevõtja, mitme relvatööstusettevõtte esindaja Even Tudeberg lahvatanud mürsuskandaali tagamaadest. Avaldame intervjuu täispikkuses.

estonia.title: Transpordiamet rajas keset riigimaanteed kolm künnist
estonia.description: Tartust Jõgevale viival maanteel tuleb Kaareperes autojuhtidel nüüd olla tähelepanelikum, sest transpordiamet lasi asulalõigule ehitada kolm teekünnist. Neist kaks paiknevad küla servades ja üks selle keskel.

estonia.title: Haigus pühkis noore naise mälust tema pere: ma ei tea, kes nad on, enne kui nad naeratavad
estonia.description: Kui 28-aastane Georgina Ann tundis ühel päeval kerget pearinglust, ei osanud ta uneski oodata, mis teda ees ootab. Süütust sümptomist sai alguse kiire ja hirmutav tervisemurede ahel, mis röövis naiselt mälestused isegi kõige kallimatest inimestest.

estonia.title: KARM KÄRBE ⟩ Air Baltic koondab 500–700 töötajat
estonia.description: Air Baltic hakkab hoogsalt töötajaid koondama.

estonia.title: Kas puidutööstur Tarmo Tamm astub välja rohelistega liitumist plaanivast Eesti 200st? «Juba patsutavad, ei ole vaja väga pikalt oodata!»
estonia.description: Eesti 200 juhtorganid hakkavad otsustama ühinemist erakonnaga Eestimaa Rohelised, Eesti 200 juhatuse ja riigikogu fraktsiooni liige, puidutööstur Tarmo Tamm kommenteeris, et sellega seoses võib tulla lähiajal uudiseid ka tema erakondliku kuuluvuse kohta.

estonia.title: «Auto ei keeranud korralikult.» Eestlase meeskonnakaaslane jäi ringrajasõidu stardis kahe masina vahele
estonia.description: Gregor Jeets ja tema meeskonnakaaslane itaallane Riccardo Ianniello võistlesid nädalavahetusel Barcelonas McLaren Trophy Europe’i autode ringrajasarjas, kus on enne hooaja viimast etappi üldvõidu konkurentsis.

estonia.title: Katastroof, mida peaaegu keegi ei märganud: talvetorm kergitas Läänemere sügavusest rannikule «surnud vee»
estonia.description: Eelmise aasta lõpus Eestit räsinud torm Johannes vallandas Läänemeres haruldase ja ohtliku nähtuse: aastakümneid mere sügavustes peitunud hapnikuvaba vesi kerkis kuni 90 meetri sügavuselt üles ja liikus madalasse rannikumerre, mille elustikule tähendas see olukord surmalõksu. Tegemist on esimese sellise teadlaste poolt dokumenteeritud juhtumiga Läänemeres.

estonia.title: USA annab Eesti piirijulgeoleku tugevdamiseks 13 luuredrooni
estonia.description: Ameerika Ühendriigid annavad Eestile piirijulgeoleku tugevdamiseks 13 väikest luuredrooni, mille päevavalgus- ja termokaamerad võimaldavad jälgida raskesti ligipääsetavaid piirkondi päeval ja öösel.

estonia.title: WSJ ⟩ Briti baasist pöördusid Ameerikasse tagasi kõik B-1 pommitajad
estonia.description: USA viis Suurbritannia Fairfordi lennubaasist ära kõik oma B-1 pommitajad, ütlesid pühapäeval Ameerika ametnikud – otsus, mis tehti turvakaalutlustel pärast kallaletungi kahtlust kõnealusele objektile.

estonia.title: Merearheoloogid leidsid uppunud vrakist tuhandeid luksusesemeid
estonia.description: Türgi lõunaranniku lähedal Adrasani juures uuritakse umbes 2100 aasta vanust antiikset kaubalaeva vrakki, mille pardal oli tuhandeid keraamilisi sööginõusid. Vrakk asub umbes 50 meetri sügavusel ning leiu teeb erakordseks see, et suur osa nõudest on säilinud tervena ja paljud neist lebavad merepõhjas endiselt virnades.

estonia.title: «Viimased 20 ringi sõitsin katkise propelleriga.» Arand võitis MM-etapi ja tõusis sarja liidriks
estonia.description: Eesti veemotosportlane Stefan Arand sai Hiinas Shanghais F1H2O maailmameistrivõistluste kolmanda etapi põhisõidus teise koha ning tõusis enne hooaja viimast etappi MM-sarja liidriks.

estonia.title: Ringkonnakohus jättis riigireetur Deniss Metsavase vangi: nii varajasel vabastamisel peavad esinema kaalukad asjaolud
estonia.description: Tallinna ringkonnakohus jättis oma 5. oktoobri otsuses muutmata Harju maakohtu otsuse riigireetur Deniss Metsavase suhtes, sest nõustus samuti, et tema tingimisi jalavõruga vabadusse laskmine oleks poole karistusaja pealt veel ennatlik.

estonia.title: UURING PALJASTAB ⟩ Selles vanuses inimesed on Eestis kõige üksildasemad
estonia.description: Kantar Emori värskest uuringust selgub murettekitav tõsiasi: Eestis kogevad üksildustunnet enim just noored ja noored täiskasvanud vanuses 16–34 eluaastat. Et ennetada üksilduse muutumist krooniliseks vaimse tervise probleemiks, lõid Apotheka ja Peaasi.ee Eesti esimese veebitesti, mis aitab inimestel oma seisundit hinnata ja leida leevendavaid lahendusi.

estonia.title: MAIT KLAASSEN ⟩ Astmelise tulumaksu tont käib jälle ringi. Rääkige siis kogu tõde!
estonia.description: Astmelise tulumaksu tont käib Eestis jälle ringi ja kui kuulata selle sisseviimise soovijaid, tekib küsimus, kas need kiitjad saavad ikka aru, et nad pole ju rääkinud kaugeltki mitte kogu tõde, kirjutab riigikogu liige Mait Klaassen (RE).

estonia.title: Kirjandusfestival Prima Vista liitus rahvusvahelise luuleplatvormiga Versopolis
estonia.description: Kirjandusfestival Prima Vista liitus septembris luuleplatvormiga Versopolis, mis tutvustab inglise keeles Euroopa luuletajate loomingut ning kus on praeguse seisuga esindatud enam kui 580 luuletajat ligemale 50 riigist.

estonia.title: REPORTAAŽ ⟩ Iiri fotograaf uurib elu NATO idapiiril
estonia.description: Iiri kaasaegne dokumentalist Anthony Haughey (1963) on karjääri algusest pühendunud piiri mõistele. Praegu tegeleb Haughey «meiega» – Euroopa idapiiriga, põhimõtteliselt Eesti, Läti ja Leeduga, esitledes oma fotodel «ajalisi» probleeme n-ö ajatult.

estonia.title: Eesti andis Ukraina energiataristu kaitseks 100 000 eurot
estonia.description: Välisministeerium eraldas esmaspäeval humanitaarabiks ligi 230 000 eurot, millest 100 000 eurot suunatakse Ukraina toetamiseks, et aidata riigil valmistuda järjekordseks keeruliseks talveks.

estonia.title: EMALAEV ⟩ CRISTINA KROON: Kui antidepressandid ei aita, võib psühhedeelikumidest saada vaimse tervise kriisis uus ravitööriist
estonia.description: Globaalne vaimse tervise kriis puudutab miljardeid inimesi, kuid kõiki depressiooni ja teiste psüühikahäiretega patsiente olemasolevad ravimeetodid ei aita. Neuroteaduste doktor ja sihtasutuse TAIP poliitika- ja strateegiajuht Cristina Kroon rääkis Kuku raadio saates «EMALAEV», miks uuritakse maailmas taas psilotsübiini ja teisi psühhedeelseid aineid ning miks ei tähenda uus ravisuund antidepressantidest loobumist, vaid arstide tööriistakasti laiendamist.

estonia.title: Igaunija maina savu aizsardzības stratēģiju un pārceļ daļu bruņoto spēku tuvāk Krievijas robežai
estonia.description: Igaunija maina savu aizsardzības stratēģiju un pārceļ daļu bruņoto spēku tuvāk Krievijas robežai. Vienlaikus valsts iegādājas tālas darbības rādiusa ieročus, lai potenciālas Krievijas agresijas gadījumā spētu pretinieku apturēt jau pie robežas, raksta ārzemju prese. Igaunijas militārās un izlūkošanas amatpersonas uzskata, ka Maskava vismaz tuvāko divu gadu laikā, visticamāk, neuzsāks pilna mēroga karu ar NATO. Tomēr […]

estonia.title: Ukraina rado naują būdą, kaip numušti Rusijos reaktyvinius dronus
estonia.description: Ukrainos priešlėktuvinės gynybos pajėgos jau numušinėja Rusijos reaktyvinius dronus, panaudodamos robotizuotus bokštelius, pirmadienį televizijos maratono „Jungtinės naujienos" eteryje paskelbė Ukrainos karinių oro pajėgų atstovas spaudai Jurijus Ihnatas.

estonia.title: Ukraina paralyžiavo daugiau kaip pusę Rusijos naftos perdirbimo pajėgumų
estonia.description: Ukraina paskelbė, kad jos tolimojo nuotolio smūgiai neutralizavo daugiau nei pusę Rusijos naftos perdirbimo pajėgumų ir tai mažina Maskvos galimybes aprūpinti savo pajėgas jau puspenktų metų trunkančiame kare.

latvia.title: Germany risks being drawn into ‘violent conflict’ with Russia, spy chief warns
latvia.description: The head of Germany’s foreign intelligence agency also cautioned that NATO countries must beware of Moscow's "little green men."

latvia.title: The 'Terminator scenario': How realistic is the AI apocalypse?
latvia.description: OpenAI boss Sam Altman and Anthropic chief Dario Amodei warn of the risks of overly rapid AI development. More experts now think AI could wipe out humanity. How realistic is that? Euronews talks to AI specialist Reinhard Karger.

latvia.title: Brazil heads to a runoff presidential vote after Bolsonaro and Lula fail to acquire outright majority needed
latvia.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazilian senator, presidential hopeful and son to embattled former leader Jair, says he is “very happy” to have led in the first round and heading into the runoff, with incumbent Lula expressing disappointment over “unexpected” results.

latvia.title: Latvia's pro-European ruling party wins election as populists gain ground
latvia.description: With more than 99.9 per cent of votes counted, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' United List party was in the lead with 35.4 percent, according to state TV.

latvia.title: Latvia: Exit polls show ruling party leading as populist party gains momentum
latvia.description: Some 1.5 million people were eligible to cast their ballots in the Saturday parliamentary election, Latvia's 11th since gaining independence from the Soviet Union in 1991.

latvia.title: „Ha felségjelzés nélküli fegyveresek jelennek meg észt földön, lelőjük őket”
latvia.description: Szakértők rendszeresen figyelmeztetnek, hogy korlátozott orosz hadművelet fenyegeti valamelyik NATO-tagállamot, például Észtországot. Toomas Hendrik Ilves, a balti állam volt elnöke a Weltnek adott interjúban elmagyarázza, hogyan reagálna országa – és mi aggasztja őt még jobban.

latvia.title: Náci karlendítés mellett „Heil Hitlerezett” a szamoai miniszterelnök egy régi felvételen
latvia.description: A vezető bocsánatot kért a 19 évvel ezelőtt történtek miatt.

latvia.title: „A világnak el kell fogadnia”, hogy az AI előnyei érdekében „néhány rossz dolog is történik”
latvia.description: Ez a mondat Sam Altman, az OpenAI vezérigazgatója száját hagyta el.

latvia.title: „Bohózattá változott a Formula–1” – kemény kritikák zúdultak a sorozat főnökeire
latvia.description: Abszurd pillanatok játszódtak le Malajziában.

latvia.title: Itt van Moszkva reakciója a NATO-ország lépésére: „ez egy vicc”
latvia.description: Marija Zaharova az orosz külügyi szóvivő reagált arra a hírre, amely szerint Észtország csapatokat küld az orosz határ közelébe – számolt be a TASzSz.

latvia.title: Kiszivárgott a haditerv: így verné vissza a NATO az ellenséges támadást
latvia.description: Új stratégiai dokumentumon dolgozik Alexus Grynkewich tábornok, a NATO európai erőinek legfelsőbb parancsnoka. A terv azt vázolja fel, miként érhetne el a szövetség gyors győzelmet a keleti szárnyát érő esetleges orosz támadás esetén - írta a Bloomberg .

latvia.title: Baleset miatt megbénult az egyik legfontosabb fővárosi pályaudvar: mutatjuk a változásokat
latvia.description: Kisiklott egy tolatómozdony a Déli pályaudvaron, ezért az állomáson csak korlátozásokkal közlekedhetnek a vonatok - közölte a Mávinform hétfőn reggel.

latvia.title: Nemecko buduje najväčšiu armádu v Európe. NATO by viedlo iný druh vojny ako Ukrajina, vraví tajomník
latvia.description: Nemecko mení odvody aj nákup techniky.

latvia.title: Najprv sa bojuje o vojakovu myseľ, až potom o to ostatné. Ako NATO cvičí predtým nemysliteľné scenáre
latvia.description: Obrana na informačnom fronte nie je len cvičenie, ale každodenná európska realita.

latvia.title: „Žiadna krajina nás neohrozuje viac.“ Nemecká rozviedka varuje pred násilným konfliktom
latvia.description: Nemecku hrozí, že bude vtiahnuté do násilného konfliktu s Ruskom, pričom hrozba útokov na ciele v Nemecku zostáva reálna. Povedal to v pondelok šéf Spolkovej spravodajskej služby (BND) Martin Jäger poslancom Spolkového snemu. Práve Rusko v súčasnosti predstavuje pre Nemecko najväčšiu hrozbu, pričom akcie nízkej intenzity namierené proti členským štátom NATO už nie sú výnimkou, upozornil Jäger.

latvia.title: Nikto nepredstavuje takú konkrétnu hrozbu ako Rusko, vravia nemeckí tajní. NATO má plán, ako ho poraziť hneď na začiatku
latvia.description: Kým niektorí slovenskí koaliční politici aj spochybňujú ruskú úlohu pri sabotážnych operáciách v Európe, Nemecko dlhodobo otvorene varuje pred konfliktom s Kremľom. Najnovšie prišlo z Berlína varovanie od lídrov troch nemeckých tajných služieb, ktorí vystúpili v pondelok v nemeckom parlamente. Šéf nemeckej zahraničnej kontrarozviedky Martin Jäger v bundestagu vystúpil s kritickým a otvoreným príhovorom. Vyhlásil, že konfrontácia, v ktorej sa nachádza Nemecko s Ruskom, dosiahla […]

latvia.title: Německu hrozí násilný konflikt s Ruskem, varoval šéf rozvědky BND
latvia.description: Německu hrozí, že bude vtaženo do násilného konfliktu s Ruskem, a hrozba útoků na cíle v Německu zůstává reálná. Řekl to v pondělí šéf Spolkové zpravodajské služby (BND) Martin Jäger poslancům Spolkového sněmu. Právě Rusko v současnosti představuje pro Německo největší hrozbu, přičemž akce nízké intenzity namířené proti členským státům NATO už nejsou výjimkou, upozornil Jäger.

latvia.title: Nobelovu cenu získali vědci za objevy umožňující ovládat buňky světlem
latvia.description: Objev optogenetiky natolik posunul lidské poznání, že za něj jeho autoři dostali Nobelovu cenu za medicínu a fyziologii. Oznámil to v pondělí dopoledne Švédský Karolínský institut.

latvia.title: Dan Dungaciu, după consultările cu Nicușor Dan: „Cotroceniul este un factor de blocaj. Soluția pentru noi sunt alegerile anticipate”
latvia.description: AUR susține că actuala criză politică nu poate fi rezolvată prin consultările de la Cotroceni și indică alegerile anticipate drept soluție. După întâlnirea cu Nicușor Dan, Dan Dungaciu a acuzat Președinția că ignoră „spiritul și litera Constituției” și a spus că „Cotroceniul este un factor de blocaj”. La rândul său, liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, afirmă că există o majoritate pentru anticipate și susține că i-a cerut șefului statului să oprească ceea ce el numește „degradarea instituției prezidențiale”.

latvia.title: „Macronomics” se încheie: de la revoluția economică promisă la criza datoriilor. Cum a ajuns Franța lui Macron „veriga slabă” a Europei
latvia.description: La aproape un deceniu de la venirea lui Emmanuel Macron la putere, proiectul său de transformare economică a Franței este pus la grea încercare. Cheltuielile publice au explodat după crizele succesive, datoria și costurile de împrumut au crescut, iar investitorii privesc cu tot mai multă neîncredere finanțele țării. În același timp, extrema dreaptă și extrema stângă promit să anuleze o parte dintre reformele președintelui, iar fostul ministru de Finanțe Roland Lescure încearcă să salveze ce a mai rămas din „Macronomics”, arată Bloomberg într-o analiză.

latvia.title: Scandal în fața DIICOT după audierea socrului lui Georgescu. Un susținător a arborat un steag și ar fi lovit cu pumnul un cameraman
latvia.description: Socrul lui Călin Georgescu a fost audiat aproximativ cinci ore la DIICOT, unde procurorii au făcut verificări asupra dispozitivelor sale electronice. La ieșirea de la audieri, unul dintre susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu ar fi provocat o altercație cu jurnaliștii.

latvia.title: Aproape 100 de amenzi la protestele susținătorilor lui Călin Georgescu de la Arestul Central. Au fost întocmite patru sesizări penale
latvia.description: Jandarmii au aplicat aproape o sută de amenzi în zona Arestului Central din București, unde s-au strâns susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu încă din momentul în care acesta a fost arestat preventiv pentru înșelăciune. De asemenea, au fost întocmite actele pentru patru sesizări penale.

latvia.title: Mesajul lui Nicușor Dan după ce susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu i-au cântat „veșnica pomenire” lui Cristian Tudor Popescu
latvia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan consideră „inacceptabile” atacurile la adresa jurnalistului Cristian Tudor Popescu şi orice încercare de a transforma un dezacord politic într-un instrument de intimidare.

latvia.title: Strategie de „apărare activă”: un stat baltic își mută trupele mai aproape de granița cu Rusia. „Obiectivul nostru este clar”
latvia.description: Estonia își mută trupele în mod permanent mai aproape de granița cu Rusia și achiziționează armament capabil să lovească adânc în teritoriul vecinului său, în contextul în care această țară situată pe linia frontului NATO se pregătește pentru o eventuală agresiune rusă dincolo de granițele Ucrainei, potrivit unor oficiali, relatează Financial Times.

latvia.title: Cine sunt oamenii care dorm doar 4-5 ore pe noapte și nu simt oboseala: misterele geneticii somnului scurt natural
latvia.description: Definiția lui Brad Johnson pentru un somn bun diferă de cea a majorității. Cinci ore îl lasă ager și energizat. Chiar și după o călătorie de 24 de ore în Europa, bărbatul în vârstă de 70 de ani din Providence, Utah, poate dormi șase ore timp de câteva nopți - dar niciodată cele șapte ore sau mai multe recomandate pentru adulți, scrie National Geographic.

latvia.title: Ce se întâmplă dacă consumi alimente bogate în zahăr pe durata tratamentului cu antibiotice. Descoperirea făcută de un nou studiu
latvia.description: Evitarea alimentelor şi băuturilor îndulcite cu zahăr pe parcursul tratamentului cu antibiotice poate proteja microflora intestinală şi, prin urmare, sănătatea generală a pacientului, conform unui studiu clinic publicat în revista Nature şi citat de agenţia de presă EFE.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu, înainte de consultări: Nicușor Dan are o abordare infantilă. O să-i spunem singura soluție la blocajul politic
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a declarat duminică seară, la Digi24, că președintele Nicușor Dan are o abordare infantilă în ce privește criza politică, pecizând că luni, la consultările de la Palatul Cotroceni, îi va spune acestuia care e singura soluție pentru a depăși blocajul: organizarea alegerilor anticipate.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu îl ironizează pe Nicușor Dan înainte de consultările de la Cotroceni. Ce melodie i-a dedicat președintelui
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a postat duminică o melodie pe Facebook și un mesaj ironic referitor la consultările de luni cu președintele Nicușor Dan, de la Palatul Cotroceni.

latvia.title: Sub gheața Svalbardului: strategiile secrete ale Rusiei care ar putea forța activarea Articolului 5 NATO
latvia.description: Activitatea hibridă tot mai intensă a Rusiei în Svalbard stârnește temeri că Moscova ar putea provoca un incident care să pună la încercare clauza de apărare reciprocă prevăzută la articolul 5 al NATO, scrie Politico.

latvia.title: Execuţia eşuată a Christei Pike: Şeful administraţiei penitenciarelor din Tennessee și-a anunțat demisia
latvia.description: Şeful administraţiei penitenciarelor din statul american Tennessee, Frank Strada, a demisionat după execuţia eşuată a condamnatei Christa Pike, care a supravieţuit injecţiilor letale, a anunţat sâmbătă guvernatorul statului, Bill Lee, relatează AFP şi dpa, potrivit Agerpres.

latvia.title: «Viimased 20 ringi sõitsin katkise propelleriga.» Arand võitis MM-etapi ja tõusis sarja liidriks
latvia.description: Eesti veemotosportlane Stefan Arand sai Hiinas Shanghais F1H2O maailmameistrivõistluste kolmanda etapi põhisõidus teise koha ning tõusis enne hooaja viimast etappi MM-sarja liidriks.

latvia.title: REPORTAAŽ ⟩ Iiri fotograaf uurib elu NATO idapiiril
latvia.description: Iiri kaasaegne dokumentalist Anthony Haughey (1963) on karjääri algusest pühendunud piiri mõistele. Praegu tegeleb Haughey «meiega» – Euroopa idapiiriga, põhimõtteliselt Eesti, Läti ja Leeduga, esitledes oma fotodel «ajalisi» probleeme n-ö ajatult.

latvia.title: Eesti andis Ukraina energiataristu kaitseks 100 000 eurot
latvia.description: Välisministeerium eraldas esmaspäeval humanitaarabiks ligi 230 000 eurot, millest 100 000 eurot suunatakse Ukraina toetamiseks, et aidata riigil valmistuda järjekordseks keeruliseks talveks.

latvia.title: Conference in Rīga to explore culture/health crossover
latvia.description: An upcoming international conference in Rīga will explore how to strengthen cooperation between the cultural and health sectors in education, its organizers have annnounced.

latvia.title: More than half of teachers are over 50 years old in the Baltics
latvia.description: October 5th is marked as World Teachers’ Day, and to celebrate the occasion, Eurostat released some data on teachers in the European Union.

latvia.title: Chestnut collector's coin to be issued in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, 8 October, Latvian Central Bank (Bank of Latvia) will issue "Chestnut", a silver collector coin with gilded details, symbolically depicting one of the heralds of autumn.

latvia.title: People smuggler, five illegal border crossers caught in eastern Latvia
latvia.description: On Saturday, October 3rd, in Krāslava municipality, border guards—in cooperation with soldiers from the National Armed Forces—detained a Latvian citizen who was transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border, according to a State Border Guard release.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs wishes 'warmth and kindness' to teachers
latvia.description: President Edgars Rinkēvičs’ office has published a text called 'Greeting on Teachers’ Day' on October 5th. Here it is.

latvia.title: Rather gloomy weather week in Latvia
latvia.description: At the start of the new working week, the summery weather will give way to cooler conditions, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Which politicians will fill the chamber of the 15th Saeima?
latvia.description: Which 100 politicians will represent the interests of voters and decide about our lives in the future? LSM.lv has estimated that the following candidates for deputies could be elected to the 15th Saeima.

latvia.title: Bridge over the Lielupe to be closed at night
latvia.description: The construction season is continuing on the national road network, with work taking place on 58 sections. From 7:50 pm on Monday 5 October until 5:50 am on 6 October, the bridge over the Lielupe River on the Liepāja highway will be closed to traffic, according to Latvian State Roads (LVC).

latvia.title: Postal votes also counted as of Monday morning in Latvia
latvia.description: The Central Election Commission (CVK) has compiled the provisional results of the 15th Saeima elections held on 3 October – including votes cast by post. According to the provisional data compiled, 806,641 voters, or 51.79 per cent of those eligible to vote, took part in the election.

latvia.title: 'Amber Latvijas balzams' moves some production to Lithuania
latvia.description: Amber Latvijas balzams, which is currently facing financial difficulties, must draw up a legal protection plan and agree it with its creditors by Monday, October 5. This plan protects the creditors’ interests and would allow the company to continue operating. Meanwhile, the company itself is optimising its costs and is already manufacturing some of its products in Lithuania, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Many voters said yes to United List, no to its candidates
latvia.description: When you vote in Latvian elections, you not only select a party, but you have the option to mark 'for' or 'against' specific candidates to move them 'up' or 'down' their respective list. PM Andris Kulbergs (United List) received the most upvotes in the 15th Saeima elections, but the 'most downvoted' list is also nearly exclusively made up of his party members, Latvian Television reported on October 5.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 4th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: The votes are in: United List handed massive mandate by Latvian voters
latvia.description: With 99.9% of the votes counted in Latvia's 2026 Saeima election, the shape of Latvia's political future for the next four years is now clear: it's tall, bald and named Andris Kulbergs.

latvia.title: Ten key takeouts from Latvia's election results
latvia.description: Here is a quick diagnosis of some of the main implications of Latvia's election result for the benefit of foreign observers who might not be familiar with the ins and outs of Latvian politics. There is some speculation and deduction involved, but that's all part of the fun.

latvia.title: Many changed their vote in this year's Saeima elections
latvia.description: The number of voters who changed their vote in the 15th Saeima elections has increased nearly sevenfold, said Māris Zviedris, head of the Central Election Commission (CVK), in an interview on Latvian Television on Sunday morning, when approximately 95 per cent of the votes had been counted.

latvia.title: New Latvian Saeima starts to shape up with nearly all votes counted
latvia.description: At 7:30 AM on Sunday, October 4, the vast majority of polling stations had counted all their votes, and according to these data, six candidate lists have an opportunity to make it into the 15th Saeima.

latvia.title: United List holds dominant position as votes continue to be counted
latvia.description: With 58% of polling stations having sent their voting results to the Central Election Commission, the United List political force of Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs holds a strong lead over its rivals in the early hours of Sunday, October 4th as votes continue to be counted.

latvia.title: Voter turnout looks like a new low in Latvian parliamentary history
latvia.description: Slightly more than half of the voters eligible to vote in Latvia's parliamentary election on October 3rd appear to have bothered to exercise their democratic right, raising serious questions about political engagement, media coverage and perhaps even whether people still value democracy as they did a generation ago.

latvia.title: How does the vote count happen in Latvia's election?
latvia.description: While the votes are being counted in Latvia's 2026 election, let's take a moment to consider how it all happens. This information comes from the Central Election Commission (CVK), which is responsible for organizing and administering all public elections in Latvia.

latvia.title: Exit poll: Kulbergs and United List on track to be top dogs in Latvian election
latvia.description: With the close of polling stations across Latvia at 20:00 on Saturday, October 3rd, the exit poll produced by SKDS has been made available.

latvia.title: Police have gone out to 20 election-related calls on Saturday
latvia.description: On Saturday, October 3, the State Police, responded to 20 separate reports of possible breaches regarding the Saeima elections, of which administrative proceedings were initiated in four cases, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Latvia continues voting in 15th Saeima elections
latvia.description: Latvians go to the polls on Saturday, October 3rd for the 15th Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Better performance from Latvia's footballers, but another loss
latvia.description: The UEFA Nations League marathon continues, in which the Latvian national team finally opened its scoring account in its third game, but suffered a loss to Montenegro 1:2.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvian party leaders' final pre-election debate
latvia.description: A highlight of the four-year political calendar in Latvia takes place on Friday night with the final pre-election showdown between the leaders of the 14 political forces contending Saturday's election.

latvia.title: It is election day in Latvia
latvia.description: The 15th Saeima elections are taking place in Latvia on Saturday, 3 October. Polling stations for voters in Latvia and abroad are open from 8:00 to 20:00 local time.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Montenegro Nations League international football
latvia.description: Latvia's football team is in action again on Friday night with a Nations League clash in Rīga against Montenegro.

latvia.title: Early voting turnout in Latvia surpasses 10% on Friday
latvia.description: More than 10% of Latvia's electorate has taken advantage of the opportunity to cast a vote before the main election day on October 3rd.

latvia.title: Latvia still lags on breast cancer screening
latvia.description: Breast cancer is one of the most common forms of cancer in the EU, and screening and other preventive measures are essential to lowering the impact of the disease and reducing mortality rates. Fresh data released by Eurostat on October 2nd to mark the beginning of Breast Cancer Awareness Month show that Latvia's screening rates remain behind most other EU countries.

latvia.title: Latvian human rights expert re-elected to UN position
latvia.description: On 1st October 2026, in Geneva, Latvian human rights expert Dr Elīna Šteinerte was re-elected to the United Nations' Subcommittee on Prevention of Torture (SPT) under the Optional Protocol to the Convention Against Torture (OPCAT) for the 2027–2030 term.

latvia.title: Who to choose in dangerous times?
latvia.description: A year and a half ago, when weighing the arguments for running for the position of Editor-in Chief of Latvian Public Media (LSM), I had to ask myself whether I would be capable of leading the creation of public media content during wartime.

latvia.title: Final day of advance voting in Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 2 October, the very last day before the 15th Saeima elections, you can cast your vote in advance. You can do this at any polling station throughout Latvia between 12 noon and 3 pm.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Birds, Mushrooms, Fire
latvia.description: What to do after you've voted? Go out in nature! Here are some events for birdwatchers, fungus fans and fire fanatics.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank issues another crypto licence to German-owned company
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka (LB) is issuing a licence to a company called Atrya Technologies SIA for the provision of crypto-asset services, the central bank said on October 1st.

latvia.title: Latvia not liable in care home detention case
latvia.description: The European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) published a decision on October 1st concerning a case brought by a resident of a Latvian care home who claimed he had been wrongfully detained by police officers.

latvia.title: Progressives' party member expelled over nature of relations with minor
latvia.description: The Progressives party has reported former party member Mārtiņš Eņģelis to the police over alleged sexual relations with a minor, newswire LETA reports.

latvia.title: Latvian government desperately tries to cut Rail Baltica costs
latvia.description: The cost per kilometre of the European standard-gauge railway will be up to 20 million euros, the government decided at a closed-door emergency government meeting on October 1, at which an informative report on the “Rail Baltica” railway project was considered. Until now, the cost per kilometre had been as high as 32 million euros.

latvia.title: Summery Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia on Friday will be mainly sunny and warm.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 1st October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Two charged over rape of minor in Vidzeme region
latvia.description: Two people are being charged in the disturbing case of a 12-year-old girl who was raped in Vidzeme region – a man who had sexual relations with the girl, resulting in her becoming pregnant, and a woman who knew about the incident and did not report it to law enforcement.

latvia.title: Reduction of fuel prices as of Thursday in Latvia
latvia.description: Across Latvia, fuel will become a bit cheaper from Thursday, 1 October. It is expected that the price of fuel could fall by around eight cents per litre. Residents in eastern Latvia have pointed out that the price reduction is too small, LSM's Latgale editorial reports.

latvia.title: More births than deaths among Latvian businesses
latvia.description: New data published by Eurostat show that in 2024 Latvia saw far more businesses opening up than closing down.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank mediates in 'Warren Buffett' bank account case
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka, the Latvian central bank (LB) and financial regulator has said it is launching a mediation process regarding difficulties experienced by "Mitek Industries", a Swedish company with links to renowned billionaire investor Warren Buffett, in its efforts to open a bank account for its spun-off Latvian subsidiary.

latvia.title: At least 110 thousand have voted in advance in Saeima elections
latvia.description: During the first four days, at least 110,000 people took the opportunity to cast their votes in advance of the 15th Saeima elections, and a further 5,000 citizens have applied to vote by post, which the Central Election Commission also counts towards voter turnout, bringing the total to 7.44 per cent.

latvia.title: Saeima rules that LSM can write in Russian only on specific occasions
latvia.description: On Latvian Public Media (LSM), content in Russian will only be permitted in exceptional circumstances, in the event of a state of emergency, or for the specific purpose of countering disinformation. This was decided by the Saeima on Thursday, 1 October.

latvia.title: 22% of Latvia's population are seniors
latvia.description: At the beginning of 2026, there were 413,000 seniors aged 65 and over living in Latvia, which is 22.4% of the total population, according to data published by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) on October 1st.

latvia.title: Latvian parliament broadens Russian food ban
latvia.description: On Thursday, October 1, the Saeima decided in its final reading on urgent amendments to the Agriculture and Rural Development Law, which provide for expanding the ban on importing products of Russian and Belarusian origin, applying it not only to agricultural goods and animal feed, but also to food products.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank issues more crypto licences
latvia.description: On 30 September, the Supervision Committee of Latvijas Banka, the Latvian central bank, decided to issue a licence for the provision of crypto-asset services and a licence to operate as a payment institution to a company called Noah LV.

latvia.title: Couple in Latvia suspected of spying for Russia

lithuania.title: Dan Dungaciu, după consultările cu Nicușor Dan: „Cotroceniul este un factor de blocaj. Soluția pentru noi sunt alegerile anticipate”
lithuania.description: AUR susține că actuala criză politică nu poate fi rezolvată prin consultările de la Cotroceni și indică alegerile anticipate drept soluție. După întâlnirea cu Nicușor Dan, Dan Dungaciu a acuzat Președinția că ignoră „spiritul și litera Constituției” și a spus că „Cotroceniul este un factor de blocaj”. La rândul său, liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, afirmă că există o majoritate pentru anticipate și susține că i-a cerut șefului statului să oprească ceea ce el numește „degradarea instituției prezidențiale”.

lithuania.title: Scandal în fața DIICOT după audierea socrului lui Georgescu. Un susținător a arborat un steag și ar fi lovit cu pumnul un cameraman

lithuania.title: Aproape 100 de amenzi la protestele susținătorilor lui Călin Georgescu de la Arestul Central. Au fost întocmite patru sesizări penale

lithuania.title: Cine sunt oamenii care dorm doar 4-5 ore pe noapte și nu simt oboseala: misterele geneticii somnului scurt natural
